correctness.rationale: For any feasible λ and center (q,z), the reflected top generator forces (1+λ)z≥1, while the bottom generator must fit in the target section [λ−(1−t)(1+λ)z]B. Its scaling factor must be at least s(B), proving λ≥s(B)+1−t for every center. For any optimal base center c, the proposed axial and horizontal center maps the two generators into sections σB and λB by exact containment and convexity; this attains the bound. Equality forces the unique axial coordinate for t<1, and the prism factors give its full center interval. The proof covers m≥1, t∈[0,1], and nonsymmetric/untranslated bases. Exact rational vertex/facet tests and 15 independent unrestricted LP cases corroborate but do not replace the proof.
